business: SEGMENT: real estate agents, St. Charles
prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in St. Charles MO to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Mark Gellman’s team at eXp Realty
engine_stated_criteria: recent sales in your neighborhood and price range
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your home’s price range, neighborhood, and how much hands-on service you want. Based on the available local data, **Mark Gellman’s team at eXp Realty** is worth interviewing if you want a high-volume operation: one ranking reports 891+ sales in the past year and substantial St. Charles activity. High team volume can mean strong marketing reach, but ask who will personally handle your listing.

I’d compare at least three agents, including a local solo agent or smaller team. For each, ask for **recent sales in your neighborhood and price range**, their sale-to-list results and days on market, a specific pricing and marketing plan, and the total commission and contract terms. Check references from recent sellers, too. Rankings and review counts are useful starting points, not guarantees of the best result for your house.
